run_inference: run inference on a Detectron model across datasets with optional multi-gpu testing and expected result checks
test_net_on_dataset: test a Detectron network on a dataset and return evaluation results for boxes, masks, keypoints, and body UV
test_net: test a Detectron network on all images in a dataset using a single GPU and save detections
initialize_model_from_cfg: initialize a Detectron model from the global config by loading test-time weights and creating Caffe2 networks
get_roidb_and_dataset: get the roidb and dataset for inference optionally restricted to a specific index range
